messages:
Rina (PM): Kickoff for the Evidence & BYOK pilot with two enterprise prospects. Core asks: BYOK handshake, signed export bundles (manifest + SHA256), retention lanes up to 7y, on-demand export SLA. Target: pilot in 6 weeks. Quick opinions?
Dev (Eng): Feasible. Need schema for JSONL export and perf estimate for large tenants. Export worker can stream gzipped parts + manifest. Rotation: rewrap without downtime.
Arjun (Security): BYOK must allow customer JWK signing of manifest or HSM signing if they opt-out. Default redaction: content_preview redacted; content_hash present. Sampling: control-plane 100%, content 5% default, opt-in to full.
Nora (Legal): We require chain-of-custody language and a retention-exception API (legal hold). Will prepare addendum with "no default escrow" clause. Also need export affidavit template.
Omar (Sales): Customers will accept add-on pricing for 7y cold archive + export SLA tier. One asks for SOC2 attachments included in export. Please confirm if that's supported.
Rina (PM): Proposal: retention lanes = ephemeral(30d), standard(1yr), enterprise(7yr). BYOK flow = upload pubkey -> token handshake -> customer confirmation. Export SLA (pilot): best-effort <4h; target <2h for gold tier.
Dev (Eng): Alpha pilot: implement JSONL snapshotter + manifest signer, background exporter, and a staging runner for scale tests. Need signoff on schema and redaction fields. I'll estimate infra cost and post PR in 10 days.
Arjun (Security): I'll publish a security checklist: KMS/HSM patterns, key binding requirements, sampling caveats. Will include forensic guidance if sampling is used.
Nora (Legal): Draft addendum and affidavit by Tue. Flag any absolute no-gos ASAP.
notif-bot: Created task INFR-5931: "Enterprise evidence pilot - BYOK & exports" assigned to Dev. ETA 6 weeks.
Rina (PM): Action items recap: Dev - proto + cost (10d), Arjun - security checklist (4d), Nora - legal addendum (Tue), Omar - customer confirmations & pricing inputs (Mon). Follow-up meeting next Mon 10am PT. :calendar:
